description: This Java source file defines the ServiceSynchronization class, which manages transaction-bound service execution callbacks for commit and rollback events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for registering services to run after transaction completion, handles synchronization with transaction lifecycle, and executes services asynchronously or synchronously based on transaction status.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization
classes.description: Manages transaction synchronization callbacks to execute registered services upon transaction commit or rollback.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization.ServiceExecution
classes.description: Represents a service execution task that runs asynchronously or synchronously during transaction completion, handling context setup and service invocation.

methods.name: registerCommitService
methods.description: Registers a service to be executed after a successful transaction commit.

methods.name: registerRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a service to be executed after a transaction rollback.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton ServiceSynchronization instance associated with the current transaction.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Invoked after transaction completion to run all registered services based on transaction status.

methods.name: beforeCompletion
methods.description: Empty method, part of Synchronization interface, called before transaction completion.
